meta.audit_summary: v5 Phase 1 (Foundation) and most of Phase 3 (Agent Migration) already landed. This follow-up covers foundation polish, 3 JSON-via-generateText bugs, 3 new CloudflareAgent @callable methods, WorkshopAgent peer orchestration, legacy cleanup, and Phase 4/5 work (HITL routes, webhooks, health coordinator, route modularization, chat schema unification, wrangler reset).

tasks.title: Add ping() @callable to BaseAgent
tasks.description: Add @callable() ping() returning { status: 'pong', agent: this.agentName, ts: Date.now() } to the BaseAgent class. BaseChatAgent already has this via ChatRoom; unify across backend agents.
success_criteria: ping() method exists on BaseAgent with @callable decorator

tasks.title: Add verifyChatFormat() static check to BaseChatAgent
tasks.description: Add private async verifyChatFormat() that uses AbortSignal.timeout(0) to probe streamText without making a real inference call. Verify env.AI binding exists, this.messages is an Array, and toUIMessageStreamResponse is a function. Integrate into healthProbe() capabilities array as 'assistant_ui_stream_compatible' or 'stream_error:...'.
success_criteria: healthProbe() calls it and includes result in capabilities
No network call observable in test logs

phases.phase: Agent Refinements — JSON via generateText fixes

tasks.title: ResearchAgent deep-reasoning → generateStructuredResponse
tasks.description: Line 27: replace deps.ai.generateText() + manual JSON parsing with deps.ai.generateStructuredResponse() and a Zod schema capturing the expected { reasoning, conclusions, openQuestions } shape. Remove manual JSON.parse. Pass { skills: this.skills } in options.
success_criteria: No JSON.parse() on generateText() output in this file
Uses generateStructuredResponse with defined Zod schema
All existing call sites of deepReason continue to work (no signature changes)

tasks.title: GithubAgent chat → generateStructuredResponse + D1 system prompt
tasks.description: Lines 185–210: (a) replace hardcoded system prompt at line 206 with await this.ai.getAgentFunctionConfig('GithubAgent', 'chat'). (b) If the chat method's output is structured (JSON parsed elsewhere), switch to generateStructuredResponse with a Zod schema. If genuinely free-form text, leave as generateText but remove the hardcoded prompt.
success_criteria: No hardcoded 'You are GithubAgent...' string literal at line 206
If JSON output: uses generateStructuredResponse with Zod schema

tasks.title: GuardrailAgent judge → generateStructuredResponse
tasks.description: Lines 46–49: replace getAI().generateText(prompt) + JSON.parse with generateStructuredResponse + Verdict Zod schema. System prompt from getAgentFunctionConfig('GuardrailAgent', 'judge'). Remove the hardcoded 'You are a senior code reviewer...' string at lines 28–43.

tasks.title: Add 3 backend-consult @callable methods to CloudflareAgent
tasks.description: Create three new methods and wire them as @callable on CloudflareAgent. (1) analyzeBindingNeeds(specs) — queries Cloudflare Docs MCP via existing tool infrastructure, returns { bindingDefinitions: Array<{ type, name, config }> }. (2) provisionBindings(defs) — returns wranglerConfigFragment only (no live CF API mutation — see PRD Open Question #2). (3) validateImplementation(code, bindingConfig) — runs CF best-practice checks (D1 batch limits, KV quotas, Workers CPU time), returns { ok, violations, suggestions }. All three use generateStructuredResponse with dedicated Zod schemas. Pass { skills: this.skills } — CloudflareAgent skills include 'binding-provisioning'.
success_criteria: Three new method files created under methods/
Each wired as @callable on CloudflareAgent index
All use generateStructuredResponse with Zod schemas
CloudflareAgent skills array updated to include 'binding-provisioning'
@callable signatures documented in method files with TS types
provisionBindings returns config fragment only — no CF API mutation

tasks.title: Wire WorkshopAgent to orchestrate peer agents via @callable RPC
tasks.description: runWorkshop (or orchestrateTasks) must sequence the full jules-stitch loop: (1) DesignAgent.runStitch(brief) via DESIGN_AGENT stub, (2) CloudflareAgent.analyzeBindingNeeds(specs) via CLOUDFLARE_AGENT stub, (3) CloudflareAgent.provisionBindings(defs), (4) EngineerAgent.overseeJules(session, { designSpecs, bindingConfig }) via ENGINEER_AGENT stub wrapped in keepAliveWhile, (5) GuardrailAgent.reviewImplementation(prUrl) via GUARDRAIL_AGENT stub. Evaluate approval + wranglerUpdated flags; loop up to iteration budget. WorkshopAgent.skills includes 'jules-stitch-loop' — pass options.skills on WorkshopAgent's own generations.
success_criteria: runWorkshop or orchestrateTasks calls all 4 peer agents via @callable stubs (getAgentByName + .method())
State persisted via this.store on each phase

tasks.title: GuardrailAgent consults CloudflareAgent for CF-specific validation
tasks.description: In reviewImplementation (or equivalent), after the local judgment, call CloudflareAgent.validateImplementation(code, bindingConfig) via CLOUDFLARE_AGENT stub. Merge violations into the Verdict. GuardrailAgent.skills includes 'cloudflare-standards'.
success_criteria: Returned violations merged into GuardrailAgent's Verdict

tasks.title: Decide LearningAgent base class (BaseAgent vs BaseChatAgent)
tasks.description: LearningAgent currently extends BaseChatAgent. v5 plan expected BaseAgent. Check: does assistant-ui have a LearningAgent chat surface? Grep frontend routes. If no → migrate to BaseAgent (remove onChatMessage override if any; update agentInit). If yes → leave as-is and update v5 plan to match reality.
success_criteria: Either class unchanged (with v5 plan updated) OR class migrated to BaseAgent with onChatMessage removed

tasks.title: Delete all todo_integration/ directories
tasks.description: Grep each todo_integration dir for imports from outside the dir. If zero external imports, delete the directory. If imports exist, migrate the needed logic into a methods/ file that extends the agent via BaseAgent/BaseChatAgent, then delete. Audited files with buildSkillContext: CfAgentsSdk.ts, LandingPageAgent.ts, Planner.ts — these are legacy and safe to delete if no imports.
success_criteria: For each dir: grep -rn '<filename>' src/ returns zero matches before delete
No buildSkillContext call sites remain (verifiable via C3)

tasks.title: Verify zero buildSkillContext call sites remain
tasks.description: Run grep -rn 'buildSkillContext' src/backend/src/ai. If any call sites remain outside skill-fetcher.ts itself, migrate them to { skills: this.skills } options pattern.
success_criteria: grep -rn 'buildSkillContext' src/backend/src/ai returns only matches inside skill-fetcher.ts (which will be deleted in C4)

tasks.title: Delete services/octokit/skill-fetcher.ts
tasks.description: After C3 confirms zero buildSkillContext imports, delete skill-fetcher.ts. Also remove AGENT_SKILL_PATHS export if consumed anywhere — grep first.

tasks.title: Delete OverseerAgent/ directory
tasks.description: OverseerAgent is already unbound in wrangler. After the wrangler reset (I8) rewrites migrations, delete the directory. Grep imports first — zero required.

tasks.title: Create thread_participants table + migration
tasks.description: Create thread_participants table with columns: id (PK), threadId (FK → threads, cascade), agentName, role ('host'|'participant'|'user'), joinedAt, leftAt (nullable). Index on (threadId, agentName). Export from chats/index.ts. Generate Drizzle migration.
success_criteria: participants.ts file exports threadParticipants Drizzle table

tasks.title: Create routes/api/hitl.ts with CRUD + approve/reject/iterate
tasks.description: Create Hono sub-router at routes/api/hitl.ts. Routes: GET /api/hitl (list pending, filterable by agentName/entityId), GET /api/hitl/:id (detail), POST /api/hitl/:id/approve { userId, feedback? }, POST /api/hitl/:id/reject { userId, reason }, POST /api/hitl/:id/iterate { feedback } (creates new version). All backed by HitlQueue. Wire in routes/api/index.ts.
success_criteria: hitl.ts exports a Hono app mounted on /api/hitl
All 5 routes implemented using HitlQueue methods
Approve triggers deferred action dispatch (via existing hooks)

tasks.title: Webhooks create HITL proposals instead of auto-dispatching
tasks.description: Current behavior dispatches directly via getAgentByName/AutomationRegistry. New behavior: for actions that modify code or trigger agents, call hitlQueue.propose({ category, entityId, proposedPayload, contextMetadata }) and return 202 with { hitlId }. Lightweight read-only events (ping, metrics) can dispatch directly. Document which events become HITL.
success_criteria: Mutating webhook events create hitlQueue rows (status='pending')

tasks.title: Per-agent health in coordinator
tasks.description: Extend checkAgentsHealth to call healthProbe() on every bound agent in parallel (Promise.allSettled). Normalize the response: each entry has { name: 'agent:<AgentName>', status, capabilities, isFrontendFacing, skillsConfigured }. Merge into the main /health response under .checks[].
success_criteria: checkAgentsHealth iterates all bound agents via env.<BINDING>.getByName('default')
Parallel via Promise.allSettled (failed agents return status:'degraded' rather than failing entire endpoint)
Each entry includes isFrontendFacing + skills_configured count
curl /health | jq '.checks[] | select(.name | startswith("agent:"))' returns entry per agent

tasks.title: Fix 3 agent.fetch(new Request(...)) sites in routes
tasks.description: Replace agent.fetch(new Request(...)) with @callable() RPC. If the target is an SSE/streaming endpoint that cannot be expressed as @callable, leave the fetch and add an inline comment: // SSE-stream: @callable cannot return a stream — intentional fallback.
success_criteria: grep -rn '\.fetch(new Request(' src/backend/src/routes returns zero matches OR only lines annotated with the documented SSE-stream comment

tasks.title: Fresh wrangler v1 migration reset
tasks.description: Collapse 7 migration tags into single fresh v1 that declares all current DO classes. Current bindings (16 DO classes): ORCHESTRATOR_AGENT→OrchestratorAgent, ENGINEER_AGENT→SoftwareEngineerAgent, GUARDRAIL_AGENT→GuardrailAgent, RESEARCH_AGENT→ResearchAgent, GITHUB_AGENT→GithubAgent, CLOUDFLARE_AGENT→CloudflareAgent, DESIGN_AGENT→DesignAgent, LEARNING_AGENT→ContinuousLearningAgent, WORKSHOP_AGENT→WorkshopAgent, CHAT_ROOM→ChatRoom, COLLABORATION_SPACE→CollaborationSpace, SANDBOX→Sandbox, JULES_WEBHOOK_BROADCASTER, PLANNING_MONITOR, REVERSE_ENGINEERING_MONITOR, AGENT_SESSION_DO, ROOM_DO. VERIFY: existing production DO instances persist through the reset. See PRD Open Question #3.
success_criteria: Single 'tag: v1' migration entry in wrangler.jsonc
Dev environment: existing data preserved after reset

tasks.title: Create shared/chat-persistence.ts
tasks.description: Create shared helper used by every agent on message events. Exports: persistOutbound(ctx, { hostAgentId, roomId?, source, userId?, role, author, content, metadata? }): Promise<{ threadId, messageId }> — creates/updates threads row, upserts thread_participants row, inserts messages row. persistInbound(...) same for incoming. Keep signature agent-agnostic so BaseAgent and BaseChatAgent can call it identically.
success_criteria: Uses getDb(env.DB) and the threads/messages/thread_participants tables
Graceful failure: logs warning, does not throw if D1 write fails

tasks.title: CollaborationSpace mirrors messages to unified chat schema
tasks.description: On post() @callable and onChatMessage, call persistOutbound/persistInbound. Each collaboration session maps to a threads row (hostAgentId='CollaborationSpace', roomId=sessionId, source='collaboration'). Each participant agent is a thread_participants row with role='participant'.
success_criteria: post() writes to unified chat schema via shared helper
onChatMessage logs assistant turn to unified schema
thread_participants row per agent joining the room
Manual: post 3 messages to a test session → SELECT * FROM threads WHERE hostAgentId='CollaborationSpace' shows 1 row; thread_participants shows all participants; messages shows 3 rows

tasks.title: Deprecate old chat schemas (agents/chat, chatRoomLogs)
tasks.description: Once all agents read/write via the unified chats schema (via I9/I10), add @deprecated JSDoc on db/schemas/agents/chat.ts and chatRoomLogs in mirror.ts. Do NOT drop tables yet — a future PR will drop after migration window.
